tools.name: open_file
tools.description: Opens a binary file with radare2 for analysis <think>Call this tool before any other one from r2mcp. Use an absolute file_path</think>

file_path.description: Path to the file to open

baddr.description: Optional base address for PIE binaries, same as radare2 -B / -m (for example 0x400000). For raw/headerless files (no ELF/PE magic), this now also creates an explicit io map so the file's content actually appears at this address, matching radare2 CLI's -m behavior

arch.description: Optional asm.arch override (eg. 'arm'), same as radare2 -a. Needed for raw/headerless binaries which cannot be autodetected and would otherwise default to the host arch

bits.description: Optional asm.bits override (eg. 16 for ARM Thumb), same as radare2 -b

cpu.description: Optional asm.cpu override (eg. 'cortex'), same as radare2 -k/-e asm.cpu

tools.name: run_javascript
tools.description: Executes JavaScript code using radare2's qjs runtime

tools.description: Executes a raw radare2 command directly

tools.description: Runs one SQL statement through a loaded SQL core plugin such as r2xsql; supports reads and writes
